title: MoGUV2: Toward a Higher Pareto Frontier Between Model Usability and Security
reasoning: The paper focuses on an architectural framework (MoGUv2) to balance LLM security (preventing harmful responses to malicious instructions) and usability. While it mentions 'aligning LLMs with human values' as a goal and 'racial discrimination' as a risk, it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning frameworks, or specific ethical theories.
